figurative_meaning_en: To get beaten and verbally abused
similar_in_english: Get the worst of both worlds
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই দুষ্টু ছেলেটা পেঁয়াজ পয়জার দুইই হয়েছে, বাবা মারল আর গাল দিল।
যখন সে ভুল করল, তখন পেঁয়াজ পয়জার দুইই হল তার।
example_sentences_in_english: The naughty boy got beaten and scolded, truly getting both onion and shoe.
When he made the mistake, he faced both a beating and verbal abuse.
history: This idiom originates from folk traditions where rotten onions and old shoes were thrown at performers or wrongdoers as a form of public shaming and punishment.
note: The idiom plays on the phonetic similarity and cultural practice of using onions and shoes for insult in rural Bengali settings.
